Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
def suffix_array_and_lcp(text):
    # Clear baseline: sorting full suffix strings is not the optimal suffix-array algorithm.
    suffixes=sorted(range(len(text)),key=lambda i:text[i:])
    lcp=[]
    for i in range(1,len(suffixes)):
        a,b=suffixes[i-1],suffixes[i]; length=0
        while a+length<len(text) and b+length<len(text) and text[a+length]==text[b+length]: length+=1
        lcp.append(length)
    return suffixes,lcp

sa,lcp=suffix_array_and_lcp("banana")
assert sa==[5,3,1,0,4,2] and lcp==[1,3,0,0,2]
```
explanation: This intentionally clear baseline sorts suffix slices and calculates adjacent LCP values directly. It is correct but not optimal; suffix-slice sorting can take superlinear extra time and memory.
